service.description: The name of the service these settings apply to.
service.security_impact: Incorrect service targeting can route sensitive traffic to unintended services or versions.
service.rationale: Ensure split traffic rules apply to the correct service, especially for production workloads.
service.compliant: service = "payments-service" with traffic routed only to approved versions.
service.non-compliant: service = "default" shared across multiple apps with traffic split incorrectly.

split.description: Mapping that defines fractional HTTP traffic diversion to different versions within the service.
split.security_impact: Controls how user requests are distributed across versions. Misconfiguration can expose users to unstable or untested versions.
split.rationale: Traffic splitting should follow staged rollout best practices to minimize security and stability risks.
split.compliant: Allocations sum to 1.0 with shard_by set to COOKIE for controlled rollouts.
split.non-compliant: Allocations misconfigured (not summing to 1.0) or shard_by set to RANDOM for sensitive services.

shard_by.description: Mechanism used to determine which version a request is sent to. Possible values: `UNSPECIFIED`, `COOKIE`, `IP`, `RANDOM`.
shard_by.security_impact: Impacts determinism of request routing. `RANDOM` may send users unpredictably to unstable versions.
shard_by.rationale: Use COOKIE for user session consistency or IP for stable routing when COOKIE is not available.

allocations.description: Mapping from version IDs within the service to fractional allocations of traffic for that version. Allocations must sum to 1.
allocations.security_impact: Improper allocations may route too much traffic to untested or vulnerable versions.
allocations.rationale: Gradually ramp up traffic allocations to new versions after validation.

migrate_traffic.description: If set to true traffic will be migrated to this version.
migrate_traffic.security_impact: Forces all traffic to the new version. Risky if the version has not been fully validated.
migrate_traffic.rationale: Enable migrate_traffic only after extensive testing of the new version.
migrate_traffic.compliant: migrate_traffic = true only after canary rollout succeeds.
migrate_traffic.non-compliant: migrate_traffic = true immediately for an untested version.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.security_impact: Ensures traffic splitting rules are scoped correctly to the intended project.
project.rationale: Explicit project definitions reduce misrouting risk across projects.
project.non-compliant: Omitting project and relying on provider defaults.
